title: This server's node
setupEnabled: Set up Xray on this server
setupHelp: After creating your account, background workers prepare the bundled node and check its connection. You can also connect separate nodes later.
initialHelp: These choices initialize the node once. Retries, restarts and upgrades preserve existing runtime files.
coordinatedHelp: Listen addresses and ports must match the installed container's port mapping and private network. Changing these initial fields does not reconfigure Docker.
statusHelp: A successful preparation means the private node connection and core responded. Service delivery and client connectivity are checked separately.
pauseHelp: Disabling preparation keeps pending work. A new request supersedes the previous preparation. Already-started work can finish; existing services keep running. The background schedules below control delivery timing.
conflict: These settings changed in another session. Refresh before saving; your draft is retained.
